candidate.name: ⚔️ Dummy R6 Hit Test Spar NPC Combat Training
candidate.creator: XzHeropfLionhzX16078

need.role: Interactive humanoid sparring dummy for strike training
need.constraints: Humanoid model with torso and head parts, unanchored joints for physics or hit reactions, roughly standard avatar scale

intent.experienceRole: Serves as the primary sparring target for testing combo timing, hit validation, and knockback reactions.
intent.interaction: Player attacks dummy; on valid contact within range, dummy flashes, takes damage, plays hit reaction, and updates health bar.

purpose: Controlled inert replay of frozen raw worker selection. No paid calls or gameplay execution.
